queries.all-edges: MATCH (s:CommerceNode)-[e:CommerceEdge]->(t:CommerceNode) RETURN properties(e) AS carrier,id(s) AS native_source,id(t) AS native_target
queries.filtered-limit: MATCH (n:CommerceNode) WHERE n.type_id = '11' RETURN properties(n) AS carrier ORDER BY n.original_key LIMIT 1
queries.filtered-total: MATCH (n:CommerceNode) WHERE n.type_id = '11' RETURN count(n) AS total
queries.grouped-count: MATCH (s:CommerceNode)-[e:CommerceEdge]->(t:CommerceNode) RETURN s.original_key AS source,e.original_type AS relationship,count(e) AS occurrences,count(DISTINCT t) AS destinations
queries.one-hop: MATCH (s:CommerceNode)-[e:CommerceEdge]->(t:CommerceNode) RETURN s.original_key AS source,e.original_key AS edge,t.original_key AS target
queries.singleton: MATCH (n:CommerceNode) RETURN properties(n) AS carrier ORDER BY n.original_key LIMIT 1
queries.two-hop: MATCH (a:CommerceNode)-[e:CommerceEdge]->(b:CommerceNode) MATCH (b)-[f:CommerceEdge]->(c:CommerceNode) RETURN a.original_key AS source,e.original_key AS edge1,b.original_key AS middle,f.original_key AS edge2,c.original_key AS target
